description: Legal Metrology compliance rules applicable to packaged commodities not fitting the other defined categories, including LPG cylinders.

rules.title: LPG cylinder check-weigher requirement
rules.requirement: All marketing companies, manufacturers, packers, importers, or distributors of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) cylinders must maintain a check weigher or non-automatic weighing instrument (digital or analogue) of Accuracy Class-III (max. 50 kg, e = 10 g) to check the weight of the LPG cylinder, and must provide the delivery man with equipment to measure or weigh the correct quantity of LPG delivered.
rules.applies_when: Applies to LPG cylinder marketing companies, manufacturers, packers, importers and distributors, effective 1 July 2013.
rules.source_text: All the marketing companies, manufacturers, packers, importers or distributors of Liquefied Petroleum Gas cylinder shall maintain a check weigher or non-automatic weighing instrument, digital or analogue, of Accuracy class-III (Max. 50 kg, e=10g) to check the weight of the Liquefied Petroleum Gas cylinder.
